ns2:course.label: Veterinary Clinical Medicine
ns2:course.description: To be used to designate a trial or experimental course for five or more students, designed to be an elective in the CVM professional curriculum. The course can be taught under this designation for two years or two offerings, whichever time is greater. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. 1 to 3 graduate or professional hours. Prerequisite: Registration in the veterinary medicine curriculum or consent of instructor.
